notes: Export correctness and performance pass. Fixes blank real-AO3 tag/stat text caused by the whole-skin text gradient overriding independent tag/metadata styles. Local preview images are now clearly marked Preview only until an AO3-safe direct public .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.gif URL is supplied, because AO3 strips embedded data-image URIs; Copy/Download warns before exporting local-only images instead of silently dropping them. Performance work coalesces live preview updates and image rendering, debounces persistence, caches generated CSS during edit bursts, deduplicates repeated CSS-output writes, and forces a fresh rebuild when editing settles or the user exports.
